title: Possum Poker
premise: Five possums are mid-hand inside a pizza delivery bag. A human hand reaches in. They all play dead without putting the cards down.
visual: Interior of an open red pizza bag, warm pizza light. Five grey possums around a slice-as-table, pepperoni chips, cards fanned. A giant human hand entering from above. All five belly-up, tongues out, still holding their hands.
characterLean: The hand is the Pizza Guy's. Face never shown. The possums have been commuting in the bag for weeks.
grokImaginePrompt: 2D hand-drawn cel animation frame in early-1990s Warner Bros. television cartoon style, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, 4:3: inside an open red insulated pizza delivery bag, five grey possums sitting around a pizza-slice table playing poker with cards fanned in their paws and pepperoni slices as chips, a giant human hand reaching down from the top of frame, all five possums belly-up playing dead with tongues out but still holding their cards perfectly fanned, warm pizza-colored light, one chip still falling, thick confident black ink outlines with slight taper, flat saturated cel color fills with one hard-edged shadow tone and no gradients on the characters, painted gouache bag interior, faint cel dust, hand-drawn cartoon, Grok Imagine style
motion: 6-second lockoff. One beat of eye contact with the hand. All five flop dead in unison — same frame, same tongues. Cards stay fanned. One ear twitches. The hand hesitates and does not grab. No faces on the human.
notes: The cards staying up is the newspaper-comic test. If they drop the cards it becomes a scare gag. Not a heist, not talking animals with jobs — they just live in the bag.
